name: Hue-style coffee
summary: Cà phê Huế at the gate is a thick cup, brewed the Huế way, in thị trấn Cầu Hai before the market.
origin: Thị trấn Cầu Hai, the town at the Bach Ma gate.
howToEat: Drink it in the morning in the town, then cross the road into chợ Cầu Hai.
where: Thị trấn Cầu Hai. The market is across the road.
seoTitle: Hue-style coffee in Cau Hai town
seoDescription: A thick coffee, brewed the Huế way, in thị trấn Cầu Hai before chợ Cầu Hai.
